cases.name: subtree-base-chain/1.1
cases.basis: Direct transcription of C14N 1.1 section 2.4 join-URI-References: ../c/ then ./d?query#fragment gives /a/c/d?query; neither oracle implements every step in this input.
cases.jdk_diagnostic: C14N 1.1 section 2.4 joins every omitted xml:base and removes the reference fragment; the JDK subtree path omits an intermediate base.
cases.libxml2_diagnostic: C14N 1.1 section 2.4 explicitly sets R.fragment to null; libxml2 retains the fragment in the joined xml:base.
